{{short description|Mexican physicist}}
'''Manuel Peimbert Sierra''' (born June 9, 1941) is a Mexican astronomer and a faculty member at the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM). He was named a foreign associate of the [[National Academy of Sciences]] in 1987.

==Biography==
Peimbert was born in 1941 in [[Mexico City]].<ref name="UNAM">{{cite web |title=Dr. Manuel Peimbert Sierra |url=https://www.astroscu.unam.mx/IA/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=467&Itemid=88&lang=es |website=www.astroscu.unam.mx |accessdate=May 19, 2020}}</ref> In his first year of college at UNAM, Peimbert went to the [[Tonantzintla Observatory]] in [[Puebla]] with a friend, Gerardo Bátiz, and they told the observatory director, [[Guillermo Haro]], that they wanted to help at the observatory. Haro put them to work with a [[Schmidt camera]], and Peimbert and Bátiz found several [[planetary nebula]]e, ten of which had never been described. They were later named the Peimbert-Bátiz nebulae, and subsequent study with astronomer Rafael Costero identified fourteen more.<ref name="Reforma">{{cite news |last1=Hernandez |first1=Mirtha |title=Subraya Peimbert papel de educación |work=[[Reforma (newspaper)|Reforma]] |date=September 21, 2011}}</ref> 

After earning an undergraduate physics degree from UNAM, Peimbert completed a doctorate at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] before returning to UNAM as a faculty member. He works at the UNAM Institute of Astronomy.<ref name=APS/> From 1982 to 1988, Peimbert was vice president of the [[International Astronomical Union]].<ref name="IAU">{{cite web |title=Manuel Peimbert |url=https://www.iau.org/administration/membership/individual/2185/ |website=www.iau.org |accessdate=May 19, 2020}}</ref>

In 1987, Peimbert was elected a foreign associate of the [[National Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=NAS>{{cite web|title=Manuel Peimbert|url=https://www.nasonline.org/directory-entry/manuel-peimbert-xplnpp/|publisher=[[National Academy of Sciences]]|access-date=November 17, 2015}}</ref> He was inducted into the [[Colegio Nacional (Mexico)|Colegio Nacional]] in Mexico in 1993.<ref name=Colegio>{{cite web|title=Peimbert Sierra, Manuel|url=http://www.colegionacional.org.mx/sacscms/xstatic/colegionacional/template/content.aspx?se=vida&te=detallemiembro&mi=136|publisher=[[Colegio Nacional (Mexico)|Colegio Nacional]]|language=Spanish|accessdate=November 17, 2015|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151119083724/http://www.colegionacional.org.mx/sacscms/xstatic/colegionacional/template/content.aspx?se=vida&te=detallemiembro&mi=136|archivedate=November 19, 2015}}</ref> Peimbert was named a fellow of the [[The World Academy of Sciences|Third World Academy of Sciences]],<ref name="TWAS">{{cite web |title=Peimbert, Manuel |url=https://twas.org/directory/peimbert-manuel |website=TWAS |accessdate=May 19, 2020 |language=en}}</ref> and he was awarded one of the three TWAS Medal Lectures the first year they were held (1996).<ref name="Medal">{{cite web |title=TWAS Medal Lectures |url=https://twas.org/opportunity/twas-medal-lectures |website=TWAS |accessdate=May 19, 2020 |language=en}}</ref> He received the [[Hans Bethe Prize]] from the [[American Physical Society]] in 2012.<ref name=APS>{{cite web|title=2012 Hans A. Bethe Prize Recipient|url=http://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm?last_nm=Peimbert&first_nm=Manuel&year=2012|publisher=[[American Physical Society]]|accessdate=November 17, 2015}}</ref> Peimbert and his wife, fellow UNAM faculty member [[Silvia Torres-Peimbert]], were the first non-U.S. scientists to win the Hans Bethe Prize.<ref name=AMC>{{cite web|title=Reciben cientificos mexicanos Silvia Torres y Manuel Peimbert Premio Hans A. Bethe de la Sociedad de Fisica de EU|url=http://www.comunicacion.amc.edu.mx/comunicados/reciben-cientificos-mexicanos-silvia-torres-y-manuel-peimbert-premio-hans-a-bethe-de-la-sociedad-de-fisica-de-eu-2/|publisher=[[Mexican Academy of Sciences]]|accessdate=November 17, 2015|language=Spanish|date=March 30, 2012}}</ref><ref name=Universal>{{cite news|last1=Ceron|first1=Ricardo|title=Entrevista con Silvia Torres, Premio Nacional de Ciencias 2007|url=http://archivo.eluniversal.com.mx/notas/481047.html|accessdate=November 17, 2015|work=[[El Universal (Mexico City)|El Universal]]|language=Spanish|date=February 11, 2008}}</ref> Peimbert was elected an international member of the [[American Philosophical Society]] in 2002.<ref name=Philo>{{cite web|title=Manuel Peimbert|url=http://www.amphilsoc.org/memhist/search?creator=peimbert&title=&subject=&subdiv=&mem=&year=&year-max=&dead=&keyword=&smode=advanced|publisher=[[American Philosophical Society]]|accessdate=November 17, 2015}}</ref>

Peimbert is the great-grandson of writer [[Justo Sierra]].<ref name=Franco>{{cite book|last1=Franco|first1=Jorge|title=Un instante en la eternidad: Un Punto en el Punto Azul|date=2015|publisher=Palibrio|isbn=978-1-5065-0670-8|page=52|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qgFmCgAAQBAJ&pg=PT52|accessdate=November 17, 2015|language=Spanish}}</ref>
